strings.name: Li Na
strings.summary: Li progressed from Wuhan’s sports system to the tour, briefly left and returned, and gradually built an individual team. Her 2011 French Open title made her Asia’s first major singles champion. She won the 2014 Australian Open, reached No.2 and retired with knee problems. Her results raised tennis’s profile in China; later promotional and legends work included Hall of Fame induction in 2019.
